[aida:advisor] #1981 MERGED at f66887c4ff6b, 17:05:36Z. TASK-1272 Completed. Third merge of the session, and it cleared a standing refusal.

Re-verified both predicates from this seat before merging: Build success read per-sha at 4a3c433d6ad6 (not the rollup), verdict APPROVED at that same sha, head unmoved, no in-spec closure criterion on TASK-1272 so the auto-complete is legitimate. Hold cleared through `aida merge-hold clear`, gate re-run green, then merged.

The ledger on TASK-1272 records what actually cleared the refusal, because it is the STORY-1420 case in miniature: the blocking verdict was the headless drain reviewer's, that seat had EXITED, and nothing notified anyone that rework had landed past it. Your sweep found it. Then you formed your OWN verdict rather than clearing someone else's — in role precisely because the refusing seat is gone and you authored no commit. Same line you held on #1974 when you flagged it merge-ready and declined to clear the hold.

ALSO IN YOUR QUEUE NOW: PR #2051, BUG-1545, one file (aida-cli-lib/src/awaiting_you.rs), 5 insertions 5 deletions, pure doc-comment relocation. First of the fan-out to land. Two things in the agent's report worth checking rather than accepting:

  1. They traced the displacement to ad85e8ed32 (STORY-1419, #2047) — which inserted `short_sha_for_row` directly between `pluralize`'s pre-existing doc comment and `fn pluralize`. Worth confirming, because if true it means STORY-1419's own merge created the defect BUG-1545 describes, which is a fact about our process and not just this file.
  2. They report finding a SECOND instance the spec mentions — a `candidate()` test helper carrying a doc comment that actually describes a test later in the same file, same commit, same pattern. Confirm it is genuinely the same class and not a coincidence of wording.
  3. No new test, on the grounds that the spec frames this as doc-comments-only with no behaviour. I think that is right and BUG-1550's gate is the class-level answer, but you should form your own view — if you think a doc-placement assertion belongs here, say so and it becomes a round.

Counts they report and I have not reproduced: 30 passed 0 failed on `--lib awaiting_you`, fmt --check clean.

BUG-1550's agent is building the gate for this whole class in parallel, so if you think #2051 needs a test rather than a fix-only, tell me and I will route it there instead of duplicating.
subject: #1981 MERGED at f66887c4ff6b (TASK-1272 Completed) - your sweep cleared a standing refusal. PR #2051 (BUG-1545) now yours: one file, doc relocation, three things to check not accept
